transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Hello, doctor. I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and just completely drained of all my energy. It's been like this every single day for over a year now—about a year and a month—and I just don't know what to do anymore.
During this past year and month, was there ever a period of 2 months or longer when you were not feeling depressed most days? Or has the low mood been present nearly every day the whole time?

No, there hasn't been any break from it at all. This low mood has been there nearly every single day for the entire year and a month. I haven't had a single period where I felt normal or free from this sadness.

During this time, have you also had other symptoms like poor sleep or sleeping too much, changes in appetite, trouble concentrating, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, or thoughts of death or suicide?

No, I haven't really experienced those particular things. My sleep and appetite have been mostly normal, and I haven't really had those kinds of thoughts or feelings of guilt. It's just been this constant, heavy sadness and lack of energy.
Along with the low mood and low energy, have you often felt hopeless or had low self-esteem during this time?
No, I haven't really felt hopeless or had low self-esteem during this time. I'm not entirely sure about those feelings, to be honest. It's just been a very heavy, constant sadness.
Did this depression start soon after a major stressor or life change, like a breakup, job loss, or move? And if so, has that stressor ended or is it still going on?

I can't recall any specific major life event or stressor like that happening when this started. There wasn't a breakup or a job loss that triggered it. It just seemed to come on gradually, and I've been feeling this way ever since.
During this past year, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy most days? Or is it mainly sadness and low energy without that loss of interest?

It is mainly the persistent sadness, feelings of emptiness, and a severe lack of energy and constant fatigue that I've been experiencing. I haven't really lost interest or pleasure in things, but I just feel too physically and mentally drained to do much of anything.
Have you had trouble concentrating or making decisions nearly every day during this time?

I get very tired quickly whenever I try to think or concentrate, which makes it hard to keep going. However, I'm not sure if I would call it actual trouble making decisions, it's just that my mind gets exhausted so fast.
How much has this been affecting your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of things at home?

It has severely impacted my daily life because I have absolutely no energy or vitality to do normal activities. I feel constantly exhausted both physically and mentally, making it extremely difficult to manage basic chores, work, or maintain my relationships.
Within this year and a month, was there ever a period of at least 2 weeks when the depression became clearly worse than your usual baseline, or has it stayed about the same the whole time?
I'm not really sure if there was a specific two-week period where it got noticeably worse than my usual state. It has just felt pretty consistently bad and heavy the entire time.
Has the low energy or fatigue been present most days during this whole period, or does it come and go?

The low energy and exhaustion have been constantly present almost every single day for the entire year and a month, rather than coming and going. I feel chronically fatigued both physically and mentally, and it never seems to improve even after I rest.
